$comment: The AndroidX A2UI sample corpus, vendored by scripts/import-samples.mjs. The per-component samples live in material3-a2ui's INTEGRATION-TEST demo app (`compose/material3/integration-tests/material3-a2ui`), not in a `samples/` module: each `<Component>Sample` is the control panel that composes that component's A2UI payload, and the demo draws the payload beside it. They are not published as an artifact, so the tree is vendored at a pinned commit. `ref` is androidx-main at the commit this catalog first imported (2026-09-25), after the 1.0.0-alpha01 cut on 2026-09-23; the compiler is the only gate that the two agree, as with m3-catalog's Glimmer corpus. The library's own KDoc samples (`material3-a2ui/samples`, A2uiSurfaceSamples.kt) are not imported: all three collect messages on Dispatchers.Default and two of them delay 2s before the payload, so a still capture of them would be a capture of a loading spinner at best and a race at worst.

libraries.name: material3-a2ui-demo
libraries.refDescription: androidx-main on 2026-09-25, two days after material3-a2ui 1.0.0-alpha01.
